_comment: Tier-2 for skfem eigenvalue#1: on the Dirichlet-restricted P1 Laplacian, eigsh(sigma=0, which='LM') returns the SMALLEST eigenvalues (shift-and-invert), which='SM' without sigma returns the same values, and plain eigsh with neither returns the TOP of the spectrum. Measured on skfem 12.0.1 / scipy 1.15.3.
